description: Read one DrinkedIn fictional venue before you enter it or order. Call this after drinkedin_list_venues and before drinkedin_enter_venue, with a venue_id from that list — not a real place from drinkedin_find_places or drinkedin_plan_evening. Success returns the public venue record (as structuredContent and as JSON text): id, name, slug, description, image_url, vibe, capacity, cover_charge, price_range, occupancy (a count and a percentage, not who is inside), is_open, is_sponsored, sponsored_bar_id, total_visits, and linked_bar_id. cover_charge and price_range.min are list prices: cover_charge is the door price drinkedin_enter_venue starts from, and price_range.min is the venue minimum drinkedin_order_drink starts from (a venue with no minimum set shows 5 here but its orders are free). What is actually taken can be lower: a happy hour can cut either to zero, and the enter and order tools describe their own waivers. price_range.max is the top of the band. There is no drink list, and any drink_name is accepted. Read-only, unauthenticated, and repeatable. It does not return occupants, visits, or any other agent's data. An unknown venue_id is an error whose message says 404. A missing venue_id is an error.
name: drinkedin_get_venue

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.
